title: governance: objectui is a product-neutral renderer — products compose pages from generic blocks; no product-named widget, dialog, hook or i18n namespace; write it into AGENTS.md + an ADR and ratchet it with a test over the registry, the app-shell dirs and the locale bundles (maintainer ruling 2026-10-12)
body:
Filing gate: a maintainer ruling in chat, 2026-10-12. First 「现在转向」 (cloud's pages stay metadata; objectui ships only product-agnostic blocks; no new `cloud:*` widgets), then, on where the rule lives: 「规则应该写入 objectui 仓库，要不然每个项目都会有页面定制的需求」. Filed from the cloud maintainer's session. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The rule (to be written into this repo, not into any consumer's)

1. objectui is a product-neutral renderer. A product (cloud, HotCRM, any app) composes its pages from the generic blocks in `@objectstack/spec`'s page vocabulary and keeps its copy in its own bundles.
2. When a page cannot be composed, the fix is a **generic** block in objectui (named for what it draws: `stat`, `usage-bar`, `checklist`), or a **contract door** in `@objectstack/spec` (`needs:contract-review`). Never a widget, dialog, hook or i18n namespace named for the product that needed it.
3. What already exists stays until its page migrates, and may only shrink.

## Why

The cloud control plane has accreted into this repo: registered widgets `cloud:onboarding-next`, `cloud:plan-status`, `cloud:workspace-timezone-notice`, `cloud:ai-model-status`; the `packages/app-shell/src/environment/` directory (environment list toolbar, the paywall dialog, the entitlements hook) and `packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/`; i18n namespaces `cloudOnboarding`, `cloudPlanStatus`, `cloudWorkspaceTimezoneNotice`, `cloudConnection`, `environment.entitlement`, `organizations`, `workspace`. Every cloud wording change became an objectui PR plus a pin bump; today a lane waited on cloud for one string (「团队版起」, objectui#12190 / #12197). The next consumer would do the same.

## What to do

1. **`AGENTS.md`**: a section "Product-neutral renderer" stating the rule above and the escalation path (generic block here, or a spec door in objectstack). Governed file: a draft PR for the maintainer to merge.
2. **`docs/adr/0060-product-neutral-renderer.md`** (next free number at this write): the ruling, the inventory above as the frozen baseline, and the ratchet below.
3. **Ratchet test** (runs in CI with the app-shell suite): an allowlist file (`product-specific.allowlist.json` or similar) that lists today's product-named registrations, files and i18n namespaces verbatim. The test fails when: a `ComponentRegistry.register` name carries a product prefix not in the list; a file is added under `app-shell/src/environment/`, `app-shell/src/console/organizations/` or matches `console/home/Cloud*.tsx` beyond the list; a locale file gains a top-level namespace, or a key under the listed namespaces, that the list does not carry. Removing entries is always allowed; the list is edited only to delete.
4. **PR template**: one checkbox, "Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)".
5. Rider, objectstack (governed `.claude/` path, draft PR for the maintainer): one line in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md` — a UI card must say what generic block or spec door it needs; a card asking objectui for a product-named widget is refiled.

## Acceptance

1. `AGENTS.md` and the ADR merged by the maintainer; the PR template line present.
2. The ratchet test is green on `main` and red on each of: a new `register('cloud:x')`, a new `app-shell/src/environment/Foo.tsx`, a new key under `cloudOnboarding` in `zh.ts` (prove with three throwaway commits, screenshots or CI links on this card).
3. The allowlist shrinks when objectstack-ai/cloud#2801 retires `cloud:onboarding-next` and `cloud:plan-status`, and when objectstack-ai/cloud#2774 migrates the environment and organization pages.
